normalized_text: five shipped strings carried long runs of literal spaces because a rust line-continuation backslash was written through a python heredoc, where the heredoc consumed the backslash first
decision_text: Deferred. The five instances are repaired and the one the gate hands back is now pinned by an assertion, so nothing is broken while this stays open. A sound detector needs Rust string-literal parsing: the signal is a long run of spaces inside a string literal not preceded by an escaped newline, and telling a literal from a comment or from ordinary code is the whole of the work. That is more machinery than one tooling artifact earns until it recurs. The cheap half of the fix is a habit rather than a gate — write Rust backslash continuations through a raw Python string, never a heredoc — and a habit is what this record exists to carry to the next agent.
